The special round under the Open Acreage Licensing Policy (OALP) is aimed at accelerating exploration in India's offshore frontier basins by lowering entry barriers, sharing the high costs and risks of deepwater drilling, and making acreage available to investors throughout the year. "Under the government's 'Samudra Manthan' National Offshore Exploration Scheme, a Special OALP is being introduced for fast-track award of deepwater and ultra-deepwater (DW/UDW) exploration blocks," the Directorate General of Hydrocarbons (DGH) said in a notice.
